source_bindings.normalization: Actual keyword_audit.normalize: NFKC, matching outer-wrapper stripping, trim, casefold and whitespace collapse. Grouping is diagnostic, not semantic or Google-variant clearance.

review_method: Read every complete title and all 338 qualification IDs/record ordinals/published statuses in source order, then manually classify all 311 canonical groups and possible wording families. The source preview scope_screen was not used to choose dispositions. Final canonical public title/ID/ordinal/status/owner strings were checked equal to the reviewed preview; the private preview is not an authority pin.

length_review_policy.basis: Conservative local compatibility-review threshold requested for this research review; this is not an established Google negative-entry limit.
length_review_policy.over_threshold_policy: Hold every original full title and its normalized group until separate literal-compatibility review; never shorten titles.

reason_definitions.FORMAL_PROPERTY_PROFESSIONAL_EDUCATION: The complete source title explicitly identifies a levelled qualification, course or formal assessment in property, housing, conveyancing, mortgage advice or property surveying. It may support only full-literal academic research relative to the unbound RNT enquiry purpose; academic meaning does not require a current course offering.
reason_definitions.ADJACENT_TRADE_TECHNICAL_OR_SUPPORT: Hold the complete title: maintenance/construction trades, safety or energy/utility/geospatial surveying, environmental building diagnosis or general housing support/communication training needs a separate scope and positive-service review. A property, housing or surveyor token alone is insufficient.
reason_definitions.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_BENEFIT_OR_ACCESS: Hold the complete title: social/community involvement, tenant support, concierge/customer service, housing access or housing/council-tax benefits is adjacent to the present narrow property-professional academic proposal scope.
reason_definitions.INDUSTRIAL_ENVIRONMENTAL_OR_NONPROPERTY: Hold the complete title: engineer/equipment, mining, arboricultural/vegetation or hot-tub surveying is outside the narrow property-professional academic scope or lacks sufficient property grounding. No generic surveyor exclusion is proposed.
reason_definitions.AMBIGUOUS_ROLE_OR_DISCIPLINE: Hold pending fuller intent/discipline evidence; no complete unambiguous property-professional academic proposal is established.
reason_definitions.SOURCE_LITERAL_OVER_80_CHARACTERS: At least one exact source title in this normalized group exceeds the conservative local 80-character compatibility-review threshold. This is not a verified Google negative-entry limit. Hold the whole group until separate literal-compatibility and occurrence-selection review; do not shorten, remove an issuer, delete a qualifier or trim a long title to manufacture a phrase.
reason_definitions.UNRESOLVED_POSSIBLE_TITLE_VARIANT: A manually identified issuer, punctuation, qualifier, assessment-version, jurisdiction or nearby curriculum relationship remains unresolved. Hold all listed groups; the diagnostic does not certify semantic equivalence or a Google matching concept.
